name: worktree-prefix
description: Prefixes a session's native VS Code tab label with the worktree it belongs to: a ticket key when the worktree directory's name starts with one, the first eight characters otherwise. Works by rewriting the outbound rename_tab request, the only route to a native tab's title.

patches.why: The session list's own fetch opts out of the worktree enumeration the extension already implements and already uses elsewhere (getSession, the resume precheck). Flipping this one flag makes a session that was already relocated into a worktree before this panel connected show up in list_sessions_response, so the prefix can find it on boot, and the extension's own worktree pill, grouping and reload resolution start working too. Optional: without it, ctx.onToolUse still catches every worktree move made during the conversation; this only recovers the session that had already moved before the panel opened.
